parsed.name: GRBL数控运动控制设备
parsed.description: 基于 GRBL 固件的数控运动控制设备，通过串口接收 G-code 指令来驱动多轴运动。常见于小型 CNC 雕刻机、运动平台或激光加工设备，在实验室中可用于样品定位、自动扫描、轨迹运动和简单加工控制。
parsed.description_en: A CNC motion control device running GRBL firmware, receiving G-code commands over a serial connection to drive multi-axis motion. It is commonly used in small CNC engravers, positioning stages, or laser processing systems, and in laboratories for sample positioning, automated scanning, trajectory motion, and simple machining control.

actions.description: 启动与设备的串口轮询通信。
actions.description_en: Start serial polling communication with the device.

actions.description: 停止与设备的串口轮询通信。
actions.description_en: Stop serial polling communication with the device.

actions.description: 清空待发送和待处理的通信队列。
以实时方式将一条 G-code 指令加入发送队列。
actions.description_en: Push a G-code command to the transmission queue in real-time mode.

actions.description: 按先进先出顺序将 G-code 指令加入常规执行队列。
actions.description_en: Push a G-code command into the normal execution queue in FIFO order.
